run_trigger_event_detector: run the trigger event detector script that publishes incrementing data messages to an event topic every 10 seconds
create_a0_publisher: create an a0 Publisher that publishes messages to a configured event topic in a loop
configure_event_topic: configure an event topic using a0.cfg and a0.env.topic to determine the publish target
publish_periodic_messages: publish periodic incrementing data messages to an a0 Publisher with a 10 second sleep interval
review_trigger_event_detector: review the trigger event detector script that uses a0.Publisher to send messages on a configured topic
